offering_description.value: Operates for-profit thrift stores selling secondhand clothing, accessories and household goods to value-seeking consumers. Sources donated goods from nonprofit partners and community donation centers, then processes and prices them for sale in its own stores.

primary_products.value: secondhand clothing; secondhand housewares; secondhand accessories and shoes; secondhand books and media; other pre-owned goods

customer_segment.value: B2C: value-seeking shoppers buying secondhand apparel and household goods; B2B: wholesale buyers of unsold goods, such as graders and resellers

end_markets.value: secondhand retail; apparel; household goods; textile reuse and recycling

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail sales of secondhand goods in thrift stores; product sales: wholesale sales of unsold goods to graders and resellers

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys donated goods from nonprofits and sells to consumers through own thrift stores; distributor: sells unsold textiles and goods wholesale to reuse and recycling buyers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Australia

specialization.value: niche specialist: secondhand goods thrift retail

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated thrift stores; other: wholesale to secondary-market buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general retail, consumer product safety and charitable solicitation rules for nonprofit partnerships

notes: Operations also extend to Australia; wholesale details are approximate.
